title: Funk Warplane Assembly
description: Large-format collage on white fabric or paper combines drawn warplane outlines with adhered compact discs, vinyl records, chess pieces, american footballs, and target motifs across a vertically oriented composition. Lower register incorporates photographic fragments, chess figures in black and ivory, and a visible 'Funk' text label amid dense concentric-ring targets.
composition: vertical stacked zones, dense center accumulation
